items.applies_to: alloys Ni-85 at.% Pr and Ni-96 at.% Pr
items.calibration: calibrated at transition temperature of high purity K2 SO4 and the melting point of Au
items.crucible: Tantalum crucibles sealed by arc welding
items.quote: The differential thermal analysis investigations were carried out in a Perkin-Elmer DTA 7 allowing a maximum temperature of about 1500 ◦ C. The thermocouples were calibrated at transition temperature of high purity K2 SO4 and the melting point of Au and the temperature measurements were accurate to within ±5 ◦ C. For the measurements, samples weighing 20-60 mg were cycled at heating and cooling rates of 10 ◦ C/min in 50 cm3 /min of Zr gettered Ar. Tantalum crucibles sealed by arc welding were used for alloys Ni-85 at.% Pr and Ni-96 at.% Pr to prevent Pr loss by oxidation and vaporization.

items.calibration: calibrated at transition temperature of high purity K2 SO4 and the melting point of Au
items.quote: The differential thermal analysis investigations were carried out in a Perkin-Elmer DTA 7 allowing a maximum temperature of about 1500 ◦ C. The thermocouples were calibrated at transition temperature of high purity K2 SO4 and the melting point of Au and the temperature measurements were accurate to within ±5 ◦ C. For the measurements, samples weighing 20-60 mg were cycled at heating and cooling rates of 10 ◦ C/min in 50 cm3 /min of Zr gettered Ar. Tantalum crucibles sealed by arc welding were used for alloys Ni-85 at.% Pr and Ni-96 at.% Pr to prevent Pr loss by oxidation and vaporization. MgO crucibles were used for Ni-rich alloys due the reaction between nickel and tantalum at high temperatures.
